text: I recently stayed at this hotel during a work trip and was disappointed by the amount of noise that filtered into my room late at night. Despite the hotel's promise of soundproof guest rooms, I found myself constantly disturbed by loud noises from an event being held nearby. As someone who needs quality rest to perform well in my job, I was extremely frustrated with this situation. Unfortunately, I can't give a higher rating due to these sleep disturbances.
title: Not So Restful Stay

text: My recent stay at Dolphin's Retreat was truly delightful thanks to the friendly front-office team and their smooth arrival process. From the moment I arrived, the staff made me feel like a valued guest with their warm smiles and prompt assistance. The property itself is beautifully designed, offering a tranquil escape from the hustle and bustle of everyday life. Although the rooms are relatively basic in design, they are well-maintained and comfortable, providing all the necessary amenities for a pleasant stay. I would highly recommend Dolphin's Retreat to anyone seeking an enjoyable getaway experience.
title: Excellent Stay at Dolphin's Retreat
